propositions: A standing recorder that appends per-criterion firing history to an incremental ledger without git-walk cost or outcome-corpus dependency is needed to automatically monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion.

The recorder must compute detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated) from sidecar re-review history alone, distinct from R7's outcome-corpus metric.

The firing ledger must be prune-immune (sidecar retention caps per-ticket history at 50 rounds), idempotent (dedup key: ticket + review_ts + round_uuid + norm_id), and auto-include all criterion ids without per-criterion registration.
Per-criterion report (--report --window N) must compute metrics over trailing N most-recently-reviewed tickets, with sample_counts denominators and null (not zero) rates when denominators are zero.
